_notes.registry: Registry covers the full teamai-class agent universe (Tencent/teamai-cli supported matrix + this machine's own agents), not just installed CLIs. Agents absent from the machine show installed=no in status and are skipped by sync unless syncWhenAbsent is set (only cursor, config-only install). Installing one of them later is picked up automatically on the next sync.
_notes.skillsFormat: Engine supports skillsFormat 'flat' (one <name>.md per skill) in addition to default 'dir'; no current tool needs flat.
_notes.licenseAndInstall: P7 (ao harness install): every tool carries `license` (apache|mit|bsd|proprietary-terms|undeclared — class assignment cites its evidence URL in the tool's _licenseNote, verified 2026-09-10) and `install` ({method, pinnedVersion, installArgs, verifyCmd}). method npm = npm install -g --prefix <managed> (HR CE entrypoint form); venv-pip = isolated venv + pinned pip (HR CE form); unsupported = no verified version-pinned channel — ao harness install refuses with guidance. Gate (plan section 8): only apache/mit/bsd install without --accept-terms <tool>; proprietary-terms + undeclared record acceptance in the managed dir and are re-flagged on pin change. Pins are static data — bump = manifest edit + re-run install.

_skipped.aider: aider appears in teamai-cli's KNOWN_AGENTS (~/.aider/skills heuristic) but aider has no real skills or file-based MCP concept (config is .aider.conf.yml flags) — nothing meaningful for harness-sync to fan out.
